listing.name: Officer Extendedest
listing.summary: Simple officer respecs. Safe to add or remove to ongoing saves.
listing.aiSummary: Allows officers to be respeced using a new mastery experience system gained from combat.

description:
Simple officer respecs. Safe to add or remove to ongoing saves.

- Respec officers using a new system called "mastery experience".
- Mastery experience is gained per-officer from combat while at max level.
- An additional 10% of mastery exp gained is gained as global mastery exp.
- A respec costs the exp needed to reach the officer's level from level 1.
- Global mastery exp can substitute for officer mastery exp if insufficient.
- All vanilla combat skills and elite skills may be changed (like AI cores!)

aiDescription: Respec officers by spending mastery experience earned while at max level. Global mastery experience can substitute for individual officer experience if needed. All vanilla and elite combat skills can be changed without altering officer levels.
